en.bdb: Touching the philosopher's stone in the form of gurmukh all the eight metals transform into gold i.e. all the people become pure.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਸਟ ਧਾਤੁ ਇਕ ਧਾਤੁ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਪਰਸਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: asaT dhaat ik dhaat paaras parasanaa|

en.bdb: Like the fragrance of sandal they permeate all the trees i.e. they adopt one and all as their own.
They are like Ganges in which all the rivers and rivulets merge and become full of vitality.
Gurmukhs re the swans of Manasamvar who are not perturbed by other cravings.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਾਨ ਸਰੋਵਰ ਹੰਸ ਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਤਰਸਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: maan sarovar ha(n)s na tirasanaa tarasanaa|

en.bdb: The Sikhs of the Guru are the paramharisas, the swans of the highest order
So do not mix up with ordinary ones and their sight is not easily available.
Craving reposed in the shelter of Guru, even the so called untouchables become honourable.
The company of the holy, forms the regime of Truth everlasing.
One Onkaar,the primal energy, realized through the grace of divine preceptor
